title: A Christmas Gift
premise: On Christmas Eve, a young couple with very little money each sacrifice a treasured possession to buy the other a meaningful gift.

chapters.title: The Gifts
chapters.story_time: Christmas Eve, in an early twentieth-century city
beats: Della counts her small savings in the couple's modest flat and worries that she cannot afford a worthy Christmas gift for Jim.
She decides to sell her treasured long hair and visits a hair buyer, who pays her twenty dollars.
Della buys a platinum chain for Jim's cherished gold pocket watch, then returns home, arranges her short hair, and worries about his reaction.
Jim arrives and is startled by her haircut; after reassuring her of his love, he gives her the beautiful combs she has admired.
Della gives Jim the watch chain. He reveals that he sold his watch to buy the combs. They recognize the love behind their sacrifices.
